purpose.summary: Attribute a hosted reproduction failure to one canonical ERGON-CHANGE-0010 scenario without exposing child output.
scope: Load the unchanged matrix driver from exact technical commit 889212482c964ec98dcc2ac55321cb0e04e17666 and require its four canonical scenario identifiers to remain exact.
Disable Python bytecode writes before importing the immutable driver so the governed candidate clone remains clean.
On a MatrixError inside one execution, emit only its canonical scenario identifier and discard the underlying message, stdout and stderr.
Keep the successful reproduction, receipt, comparison, cleanup and promotion behavior unchanged.
exclusions: No workflow, container, dependency, production-node build, node, consensus, validation, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet, mainnet, or operator-binary change.
No modification of the accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0010 technical target, matrix bytes, scenarios, functional scripts, inherited selection, existing report or semantic projection.
No source bytecode or cache write is permitted while loading the immutable matrix driver.
No child stdout, stderr, traceback, command, path, port, environment, secret or free-form error text is retained or printed.
No retry, incoming evidence, workflow artifact, proof promotion, deterministic-build claim, public-network claim or mainnet-coexistence claim.

limitations: Publishing this diagnostic change does not reproduce ERGON-CHANGE-0010 and does not authorize a rerun or evidence promotion.
The bounded diagnostic identifies only the failing canonical scenario; it intentionally does not expose the assertion, traceback, process output, path, port, environment or root cause.

A successful future hosted comparison can cover only the existing bounded synthetic regtest matrix; it cannot establish deterministic builds, operator-binary equivalence, historical-chain replay, public-network peering, sustained operation or mainnet coexistence.
The ERGON-CHANGE-0010 report remains Observed with an assembled-component ceiling until a separate accepted evidence promotion binds an independent successful execution.
